action_description: 16-frame compact melee strike using only the referenced weapon or limb. Frame 1 stays unchanged; 2-5 anticipate, 6-9 strike and contact, 10-12 follow through, and 13-16 recover.
locked_constraints: keep the feet on the same ground line
do not move the whole character across the canvas
preserve an existing weapon exactly; invent none
show no target, projectile, text, or impact effect
preserve outfit, proportions, palette, equipment, and limbs
